title: 第五章 朕或许需要一个豆包第六章 钟鸣太华宗
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
夕日西下，晚霞熔金。
“驾！”
疾驰骏马踏过青石路，直入王城。
昭临阁，皇帝处理政务之所在。
昏黄的余晖透过窗子，洒在温婉美人的脸上，睫影在暖光中轻颤，水晶般明眸之中满是眼前人的面容，她探出手来，指尖轻轻临摹着他的脸。
掌管天下的君王，此刻就躺在她的膝上，手掌摩挲，闭目养神。
安静祥和，岁月静好。
“报～”
忽而，门外一声侍者呼喊，却是打破了这美好的静谧，谢苍荣睁开了眼睛。美人顿了顿，便自觉为他整理好衣襟，素手轻轻捋了捋谢苍荣的鬓发，语声轻婉：“陛下，臣妾告退～”
谢苍荣笑了笑：“去罢！”
过了一会儿，侍者领着一士兵进了门。
谢苍荣靠着椅子，笑问道：“可是宁伯兴那里来消息了？”
面见君王这样的机会可是不多的。
士兵有些激动，眼中俱是狂热的信仰：“回禀陛下，宁将军正在回来的路上，特命卑职快马加急，此物送回烈阳，交予陛下。”
他小心翼翼的拿出盒子来，双手交予侍者。
谢苍荣瞥了眼盒子，并没有立刻打开，只是笑呵呵地赞了他一句，颇为随和：“是嘛！辛苦了～这么快送来，这一路怕是没停歇吧！”
士兵赶忙道：“将军嘱托，家国大事，臣不敢不尽心竭力！”
“我记得，你是叫马承勇……对吧？越州人？”
也不知怎的，马承勇莫名有种感觉，陛下的视线仿佛可以穿透灵魂，将他整个人都看了个通透一般。
可随即，这种感觉便是被汹涌澎湃的激动感激淹没了，陛下这等人竟然还记得他这样微末小卒的名字。

何其幸甚！何其荣光！
他面色涨红，扑通跪倒：“陛下，卑职……卑职正是马承勇，越州柳武县人。”
谢苍荣朗声一笑，起身接过锦盒，顺手拍了拍他的肩：“哈哈，起来，不必拘礼。”
“既是一路疾驰未停，粒米未进，就在朕这里吃点吧。”
说着，朝着侍者摆了摆手：“杨礼，领他去吃点东西吧。”
“是！”
侍者应下，便是带着有些呆愣士兵远去。
待到走出宫门，马承勇这才回过神来，他猛地定住脚步，转身回望那巍峨殿宇，眼中热泪盈眶，发自肺腑地朝着那至高之处拜了又拜。
“陛下……”
如此明主指掌乾坤，如何能不教人肝脑涂地，誓死追随呢？
一旁的侍者不住笑笑：“马将军，咱们陛下德行深如瀚海，这可不是谣传的。”
“随我来吧，吃饱了饭，才好为咱们陛下尽心做事啊！”
“是！”
几个下属离去，昭临阁便只剩下了谢苍荣一人。
content_en:
As the sun sets in the west, the sunset melts gold.
"Drive!"
The galloping horses crossed the bluestone road and entered the royal city.
Zhaolin Pavilion is where the emperor handles government affairs.
The dim afterglow shines through the window and onto the face of the gentle beauty. The shadows of her eyelashes tremble slightly in the warm light. The face of the person in front of her is full of her crystal-like bright eyes. She reaches out her hand and lightly traces his face with her fingertips.
The king in charge of the world was lying on her lap, stroking her with his hands, closing his eyes and concentrating.
Quiet and peaceful, the years are quiet.
"Report~"
Suddenly, a waiter shouted outside the door, breaking the beautiful silence, and Xie Cangrong opened his eyes. The beauty paused, and then she took it upon herself to tidy up his clothes. She gently stroked Xie Cangrong's hair with her bare hands, and said in a gentle voice, "Your Majesty, I am leaving this concubine~"
Xie Cangrong smiled: "Go!"
After a while, the waiter led a soldier through the door.
Xie Cangrong leaned on the chair and asked with a smile: "But where is the news from Ning Boxing?"
Opportunities like this to meet the king are rare.
The soldier was a little excited, with fanatical belief in his eyes: "Reporting to your majesty, General Ning is on his way back. He specially ordered me to hurry up and send this thing back to Lieyang and hand it over to your majesty."
He carefully took out the box and handed it to the waiter with both hands.
Xie Cangrong glanced at the box, but did not open it immediately. He just praised him with a smile and said in a very easy-going manner: "That's right! Thank you for your hard work! It was delivered so quickly. I'm afraid it didn't stop all the way!"
The soldier hurriedly said: "The general has entrusted me with important matters for my family and my country. I dare not fail to do my best!"
"I remember, your name is Ma Chengyong...right? You're from Yuezhou?"
Somehow, Ma Chengyong had an inexplicable feeling that His Majesty's gaze seemed to penetrate his soul and see his entire being.
But then, this feeling was overwhelmed by the surge of excitement and gratitude that people like His Majesty still remembered the name of such a humble person like him.
What a blessing! What an honor!
His face turned red and he fell to his knees: "Your Majesty, I am humble... I am Ma Chengyong, a native of Liuwu County, Yuezhou."
Xie Cangrong laughed loudly, stood up, took the brocade box, and patted his shoulder: "Haha, get up, there is no need to be polite."
"Since you have been galloping all the way and haven't eaten a grain of rice yet, just eat some here."
As he said that, he waved his hand towards the waiter: "Yang Li, take him to have something to eat."
"Yes!"
The waiter agreed and led the somewhat stunned soldiers away.
When he walked out of the palace gate, Ma Chengyong came back to his senses. He stopped suddenly, turned around and looked back at the majestic palace, with tears in his eyes, and worshiped again and again towards the highest place from the bottom of his heart.
"Your Majesty..."
With such a clear master in control of the world, how can he not make people become confused and follow him to death?
The waiter on the side couldn't help but smile: "General Ma, our Majesty's virtue is as deep as the vast sea. This is not a rumor."
"Come with me. Only after you have eaten enough can you do your best for our Majesty!"
"Yes!"
Several subordinates left, and Xie Cangrong was the only one left in Zhaolin Pavilion.
